description: During a 3-month internship at CV Jala Arta, I was responsible for the maintenance and repair of essential electrical appliances. My primary duties included performing regular maintenance, analyzing hardware failures, and troubleshooting Air Conditioning (AC) units to ensure optimal cooling performance. Additionally, I successfully diagnosed and fixed mechanical and electrical issues in other key equipment, specifically refrigerators and washing machines. This experience significantly sharpened my practical skills in electronic troubleshooting, component identification, and hands-on mechanical repairs.
